subject: Interim Superintendent Conflict of Interest Disclosure
overview: The Medford School Committee met to consider a conflict of interest disclosure submitted by Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi. The committee voted to approve her participation in collective bargaining negotiations with the teachers union.

items.title: Interim Superintendent Conflict of Interest Disclosure
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution allowing Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi to participate in contract negotiations with the Medford Teachers Association following disclosure that her spouse is a union member.
